theorems.name: Submission.cbrcs_ce_imrep_lift_univ
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → R.carrier ⊆ K → ∃ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.carrier = R.carrier ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient
